canonical_project: Mauritius Telecom Rose Hill Tier III Data Centre (RHDC)
notes: MT/my.t colocation page (checked 2026-08-12) describes the Rose Hill Data Centre, Tier III compliant, in the centre of Mauritius (Rose Hill, Plaines Wilhems), with 300 sq m secured rack space, up to 60+ racks and 500 kW of power. 0.5 MW is the operator-stated power figure.
